Attached: 1 image

Plainva 0.8.7 is out for desktop, Android and iOS TestFlight.

Every account signs in once for files, calendar and mail, and Google works with Plainva's own sign-in. One assistant connects every provider, the settings can be searched, task queries from Obsidian show as task lists, and checkbox tasks with a time can remind you. Please update every device.

https://plainva.com/blog/plainva-0-8-7
